metadata.remarks: Authoritative OSCAL v1.2.3 Component Definition for Cohere North 2 sovereign enterprise AI platform, North Admin governance console, Command R+, Embed v3, Rerank v3, and air-gapped / private VPC Kubernetes deployments under NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5.

components.title: Cohere North 2 Agentic AI Platform & Orchestration Fabric
components.description: Enterprise agentic AI orchestration platform enabling the design, multi-step execution, and management of AI agents and automations within self-hosted, private cloud, or air-gapped environments. Features persistent agent memory across sessions, enterprise connector integrations (Slack, GitHub, SharePoint), and shared skill libraries.
components.purpose: Coordinates complex, multi-step enterprise workflows and autonomous task execution while ensuring all data, context, and model weights remain inside customer-governed sovereign infrastructure boundaries.

props.name: memory-persistence
props.value: Encrypted Session Context with State Vector Preservation

props.name: connector-fabric
props.value: Enterprise Tool Connectors with Granular ACLs

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Moderate and High baseline security control implementations provided by Cohere North 2 platform and North Admin governance plane.

implemented-requirements.description: North Admin integrates with enterprise Identity Providers via OIDC, SAML 2.0, and SCIM 2.0 for automated account lifecycle management. Supports workspace isolation, role-based access control (RBAC), and automated deprovisioning.

statements.description: Automates account lifecycle management through SCIM 2.0 sync with corporate enterprise directories. Enforces granular RBAC roles (Enterprise Admin, Workspace Manager, Agent Operator, Read-Only Auditor) across all workspaces and agent environments, immediately revoking credentials upon employee termination.

implemented-requirements.description: Enforces runtime logical access boundaries, agent tool invocation permissions, and autonomy policies. North Admin enables administrators to enforce human-in-the-loop approval gates before agents can execute destructive actions, access external databases, or call third-party APIs.

statements.description: Enforces strict authorization for all model queries and agent tool invocations. North Admin autonomy policies gate privileged or state-mutating actions behind cryptographically verified human approvals, preventing autonomous agents from exceeding granted capability bounds.

implemented-requirements.description: Enforces complete information flow control and network enclave isolation. In air-gapped and private VPC deployments, model inference runs entirely within customer-controlled Kubernetes clusters. Customer data is processed in ephemeral GPU Key-Value memory and zeroized upon request completion with Zero Data Retention.

statements.description: Controls information flow across sovereign network enclaves. Enforces strict cryptographic isolation between workspace tenants, wipes GPU memory KV-caches immediately upon generation completion, and guarantees that customer prompts and embeddings never egress customer-managed VPC boundaries.

implemented-requirements.description: Enforces the principle of least privilege across human users and autonomous AI agents. North Admin restricts agent access strictly to authorized skills, specific document indexes, and scoped API connectors, preventing excessive agency or unbounded system command execution.

statements.description: Restricts autonomous agent tools to least-privilege configurations. Each agent is provisioned with narrow tool access lists and read-only connectors where appropriate, blocking access to arbitrary shell execution, host operating system interfaces, or unapproved network endpoints.

implemented-requirements.description: North Admin records immutable, structured audit records for all user authentications, model inference requests, agent tool executions, autonomy approvals, spend limit threshold triggers, and administrative configuration changes. Audit logs are streamable to enterprise SIEM platforms (Splunk, Datadog, Elasticsearch).

statements.description: Generates structured JSON audit logs capturing UTC timestamp, caller identity, tenant ID, model ID, input/output token counts, tool execution signatures, and guardrail trigger flags, streaming records to customer SIEM destinations while adhering to Zero Data Retention payload privacy rules.

implemented-requirements.description: Uniquely identifies and authenticates human operators and programmatic workloads. Integrates with corporate identity providers via OIDC and SAML 2.0 with mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) utilizing FIDO2 / WebAuthn keys. Programmatic access uses scoped high-entropy API tokens with configurable expiration.

statements.description: Authenticates all administrative and API users prior to granting access to North console or model runtimes. Enforces hardware MFA (FIDO2) for interactive web console access and mTLS or high-entropy tokens for programmatic inference endpoints.

implemented-requirements.description: Protects against denial of service and runaway token consumption. North Admin implements real-time spend management: per-user token quotas, per-agent rate limits, sliding-window request throttling, and organization-wide hard spend caps that automatically freeze execution when budgets are exhausted.

statements.description: Enforces rate limiting, token throttling, and budget caps at API ingress gateways. Automatically sheds excessive requests, rejects runaway recursive agent loops, and enforces organization-level spend limits to prevent denial of service and financial exhaustion.

implemented-requirements.description: Enforces strict boundary protection. In sovereign on-premises or private VPC deployments, Cohere North operates within private non-routable subnets with deny-all default egress rules. Air-gapped installations require no external network connectivity, ensuring zero outbound telemetry or weight exfiltration.

statements.description: Isolates model serving and orchestration infrastructure within private network zones. Blocks all unapproved outbound network connections with stateful egress firewalls, operating fully air-gapped without external dependencies or phone-home telemetry.

implemented-requirements.description: Employs FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic modules for data encryption at rest and in transit. Supports Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault Managed HSM, or HashiCorp Vault. All internal gRPC and external HTTPS communications mandate TLS 1.3.

statements.description: Enforces AES-256-GCM encryption for all persistent data and model weights at rest using FIPS 140-3 validated HSMs, and enforces TLS 1.3 with Perfect Forward Secrecy for all data in transit across internal and external network channels.

implemented-requirements.description: North Admin deploys in-line security monitoring and real-time safety guardrails across all inference requests. Scans prompts and completions for adversarial prompt injection, jailbreak sequences, and token distribution anomalies, alerting security personnel and tripping circuit breakers upon detection.

statements.description: Continuously monitors system inputs and model completions using dedicated in-line classifiers to detect prompt injection, adversarial evasion, and malicious payload executions, automatically neutralizing threats and alerting administrators via North Admin.

implemented-requirements.description: Performs strict structural and content input validation on all API requests and agent connector inputs. Integrates automated PII detection and redaction, Unicode normalization, JSON schema boundary verification, and sanitization of user-provided prompt delimiters.

statements.description: Validates all input payloads against strict RFC 8259 schemas and token boundaries. Enforces automated PII scanning to redact sensitive personal data before processing, rejecting malformed, truncated, or adversarial delimiter injection attempts.

implemented-requirements.description: Implements software supply chain risk management for all container images, model weights, and Helm charts. Supports air-gapped distribution via local mirrored registries with Sigstore Cosign cryptographic signatures and SLSA provenance attestations.

statements.description: Validates the cryptographic integrity and provenance of all container images, model checkpoint weights, and deployment manifests using Sigstore Cosign and SLSA attestations before permitting deployment into sovereign Kubernetes clusters.

components.title: Cohere North Admin Governance & Security Console
components.description: Centralized enterprise management control plane providing real-time spend management, user/agent token quotas, fine-grained RBAC, native IdP integration (OIDC/SAML/SCIM), agent autonomy policies, human-in-the-loop approval gates, in-line guardrails (PII scanning and prompt injection detection), and audit logging.
components.purpose: Eliminates black-box AI risks by enforcing administrative boundaries, spending caps, and human-in-the-loop authorization gates over all agent tools and model interactions.

props.name: spend-management
props.value: Per-User, Per-Agent Quotas & Organization Spend Caps

props.name: in-line-guardrails
props.value: PII Detection, Prompt Injection Classification & Output Filters

props.name: identity-integration
props.value: OIDC / SAML 2.0 / SCIM 2.0 Enterprise Directory Sync

components.title: Cohere Command R+ Foundation Model Runtime
components.description: State-of-the-art multilingual enterprise foundation model optimized for conversational interaction, advanced reasoning, complex retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with verifiable citations, and multi-step tool use across 128,000 token context windows.
components.purpose: Powers highly accurate text generation, reasoning, and automated tool invocation with native citation grounding and minimal hallucination.

components.title: Cohere Embed v3 & Rerank v3 Semantic Search Subsystem
components.description: High-performance enterprise semantic search and retrieval subsystem consisting of Cohere Embed v3 (multilingual embeddings with int8 and binary compression) and Cohere Rerank v3 (relevance scoring and semantic re-ranking for enterprise search pipelines).
components.purpose: Enables dense vector retrieval, semantic search, and document reranking with compression to minimize GPU memory consumption and search latency.

components.title: Cohere Sovereign Air-Gapped / Private VPC Enclave
components.description: Self-hosted deployment infrastructure package running on Kubernetes via Helm charts in customer-managed virtual private clouds (AWS VPC, Azure VNet, OCI, GCP) or on-premises air-gapped data centers. Ensures complete isolation with no telemetry egress, no public internet access, and full local model weight custody.
components.purpose: Provides complete data sovereignty, zero external data leakage, and compliance with national security, defense, and strictly regulated industry mandates.
